answer: Farming becomes an orchard bet on surviving 116 epochs of grading, and every hollow settlement recomputes the vine schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 116 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 15 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 5 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
